response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating;
